title: Siegard plan graph
description: The derived index of a work root. Never authored and never edited: `bin/plan.py` derives it from the markdown plan nodes, and `--check` holds a committed copy to them. Nodes are the files; edges are the references their frontmatter declares. `implements` and `covers` edges point outside the plan, at specification nodes — the plan's whole reason to exist — so a consumer resolving them opens the specification root, not this file.

file.description: The node's file, relative to the work root. Always `<id>.md`.

epic.description: The epic a task sits under, read from its path. Tasks only.

to.description: A task of this plan for `depends_on`; a specification node for `implements` and `covers`.

at.description: Where in the source node the reference sits, so a reader can open the place a defect names.
